readmeExcerpt: Qiskit Machine Learning introduces fundamental computational building blocks, such as Quantum Kernels and Quantum Neural Networks, used in various applications including classification and regression. This library is part of the Qiskit Community ecosystem, a collection of high-level libraries that are based on the Qiskit software development kit. As of version 0.7, Qiskit Machine Learning is co-maintained by IBM and the Hartree Centre, part of the UK Science and Technologies Facilities Council (STFC).
